<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-INS-006</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Installation and upgrade</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Platform Manager **Update**; Docker logs</b></div></div>

## Why it happens

One step of the upgrade failed, for example a database migration, a download or a service that would not start.

## Fix it

- **Platform Manager** has already put the previous version and its database copy back. Open **Logs** to see which step failed and send the log to support.
- **Docker**: read `docker compose -f <compose file> logs sentient` for the failed step. Go back to the previous image tag and restore the backup you made before the upgrade.

## Check that it worked

SENTIENT runs on the previous version, and the **Status** page shows all services running.
